Mr. Hyde noted that the recommendation of the working group was to expand the Large CAFO area to include all of the Pleasant Valley area to the Uintah County line and to establish an overlay zone in the Arcadia area, around 4-C Farms. The ordinance text has been amended to remove the requirement for anaerobic digesters as those would be considered as part of the Comprehensive Nutrient Management Plan. It has been indicated that anaerobic digesters are not effective in colder climates like the Uintah Basin. The text has been amended to clarify that a change in ownership or operator of a Large CAFO would not affect the land use status of the facility, provided that it continues to be operated in accordance with state and federal requirements.
